description: The life of one match as the transport sees it: the in-game lobby, the two eras, and the turn machine repeated inside each. Not the internal state of any participant.

lobby.description: The match exists and seats are being claimed. Every seated client is simultaneously active — boardgame.io's ActivePlayers.ALL — so colour, avatar and ready arrive in any order.

HOST_START.guard: the caller is seat 0 and at least two seats are joined, coloured and ready
HOST_START.description: The only move in the whole game restricted to one seat. hostID is hard-wired to "0", which is whoever created the match.

canal-era.description: Canal era. Level-1 industries are buildable, only canal links may be laid, and round 1 grants a single action instead of two.

ERA_OVER.guard: the deck is empty and every hand is empty
ERA_OVER.description: Scoring is an action on this edge rather than a state of its own: the supported XState subset has no eventless transition, so a scoring state would need an invented event to leave it — and endEra does exactly this, in one pass.

turn-start.description: A seat is on turn with its action budget intact.

MAKE_MOVE.guard: budget remains after this action and the hand is not empty
MAKE_MOVE.description: Two actions per turn, except canal-era round 1, which grants one.

action-pending.description: One action taken, one left. The turn-scoped undo stack is live here — anything since turn start can still be reverted.

awaiting-commit.description: The budget is spent (or the hand emptied). The only legal move is confirmTurn — the engine does not end a turn by itself. See 0001-turn-commit-gate.

CONFIRM_TURN.guard: the committing seat is not last in turn order

CONFIRM_TURN.description: End of round: income is collected before turn order is recomputed by spend, and the round counter advances.

rail-era.description: Rail era. The same turn machine, with rail links, beer-paid double links, and the level-1 tiles gone.

ERA_OVER.guard: the deck is empty and every hand is empty
ERA_OVER.description: No income is collected in the final round — the game ends on scoring. computeWinner resolves ties by VP, then income level, then money, and may return several seats.

turn-start.description: A seat is on turn with both actions available.

MAKE_MOVE.guard: budget remains after this action and the hand is not empty

awaiting-commit.description: Waiting for confirmTurn, exactly as in the canal era.

CONFIRM_TURN.guard: the committing seat is not last in turn order

finished.description: endIf has fired. ctx.gameover carries winner and winners; a shared victory is a normal outcome, not an error state.
